name: poc-ssr

scripts.clean:nf-cache: node -e "for (const d of ['node_modules/.cache/native-federation', 'ng21/node_modules/.cache/native-federation']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:mfes: ng build mfe-orders && ng build mfe-orders-federated
scripts.build:hosts: ng build host && ng build host-shared
scripts.build:hosts:dev: ng build host -c development && ng build host-shared -c development
scripts.build: npm run clean:nf-cache && npm run build:mfes && npm run build:ng21 && npm run build:hosts && npm run assemble
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean:nf-cache && ng build mfe-orders && ng build mfe-orders-federated -c development && npm --prefix ng21 run build:dev && npm run build:hosts:dev && npm run assemble

description: Fragment SSR for web-component MFEs: Angular SSR hosts splice server-rendered MFE fragments into custom elements, which take over on the client.
